review_evidence: I directly read pinned raw HTML S3.SS1.p1, S3.E4; A2.SS2.p1 (standing n≥3, κ≥4 and Haar O on full O(n)); A2.Thmtheorem6/Eq15; and A2.SS2.SSS1.p2 through A2.E16, A2.Ex52, the invertibility/continuity paragraph, A2.E17, A2.E18X and A2.E18Xa. Eq4 has precisely ((κ+1)/2)I−((κ−1)/4)(O+Oᵀ). Eq18 first has Oᵀ and then O, with the source explicitly invoking transpose invariance. For Eq16, expanding MᵀM with OᵀO=I gives ((s+1)²+(s−1)²)I−(s+1)(s−1)(O+Oᵀ); s²=κ yields the literal Eq4 coefficients after multiplication by 1/4. The first lesson displays exactly this calculation and the actual theorem proof performs it entrywise. Its n≥3 binder is retained even though algebra does not consume it. I checked the full packet module, including private shiftedOrthogonal_det_pos: from 0≤b<a and t∈[0,b], a>0 and a²−t²>0. Orthogonality gives (Ov)·(Ov)=v·v. A zero determinant yields a nonzero kernel vector, av=tOv, and hence (a²−t²)(v·v)=0, contradicting v·v>0. The continuous determinant path starts at det(aI)=a^n>0; an endpoint ≤0 would cross zero by IVT. Thus its endpoint is positive for every orthogonal O, without any determinant-component restriction. Instantiating a=sqrt(κ)+1,b=sqrt(κ)−1 uses κ≥4 to obtain sqrt(κ)≥2; these are derived facts, not additional source binders. The source proves ||(aI−tO)v||≥(a−t)||v||≥2||v|| on 0≤t≤sqrt(κ)−1, then uses invertibility and continuity. Lean proves the same required nonsingularity by a squared-coordinate-norm kernel contradiction and continuity. This is a valid alternate route to the sign conclusion; the quantitative norm inequality itself is not a separately formalized theorem in the supplied module. The English lesson explicitly discloses this distinction. Its claim that the estimate is retained elsewhere in the source graph is outside these permitted review inputs and is not independently certified here. I read only the three reviewer packets and pinned raw source; no previous semantic/topology verdict or parent rationale was read. Supplied PASS(2278), compilation, standard-three-axiom and anonymous-expanded-type reports are context only, not my source-fidelity evidence. This is a source/whole-module/exposition review, not independent root admission or an aggregate VERIFIED claim.
